bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
names="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}')"
gay="$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' || true)"
pg="$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$gay" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_GROUP_CONTAINER_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 65; }
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || { echo STK04_POSTGRES_CONTAINER_NOT_UNIQUE; exit 66; }
printf 'STK04_GROUP_RUNTIME=READY\n'
docker exec "$gay" node -e 'const fs=require("fs");(async()=>{const path=process.env.BOT_TOKEN_FILE;const token=path?fs.readFileSync(path,"utf8").trim():process.env.BOT_TOKEN;if(!token)throw Error("GROUP_CREDENTIAL_ABSENT");async function call(method,arg){const r=await fetch("https://api.telegram.org/bot"+token+"/"+method,{method:"POST",headers:{"content-type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(arg),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)});const j=await r.json();if(!j.ok)throw Error("API_"+method+"_FAILED");return j.result;}const me=await call("getMe",{});if(me.username?.toLowerCase()!=="gaybbs_bot")throw Error("GROUP_IDENTITY_WRONG");const member=await call("getChatMember",{chat_id:-1002373696859,user_id:me.id});console.log("STK04_GROUP_BOT=VERIFIED");console.log("STK04_GROUP_MEMBERSHIP="+member.status);console.log("STK04_GROUP_CAN_PIN="+(member.can_pin_messages===true?"YES":"NO"));})().catch(e=>{console.log("STK04_PROBE_ERROR="+e.message);process.exitCode=2})'
printf 'STK04_DATABASE_CANDIDATES\n'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -At -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE datallowconn AND NOT datistemplate ORDER BY datname"' | head -n 25
printf 'STK04_PREFLIGHT_DONE\n'
